_meta.source: World Aquatics Appendix 3 — Set Times and Number of Elements for Routines (DRAFT, version September 27th 2026)
_meta.purpose: Set numbers of elements for routines, used to validate coach cards
notes: 12U and Youth share one table in 2027; Acrobatic Routine is Youth only and Open Free Combination is 12U only.
Time tolerance is +/- 5 seconds (time is not checked by the app).

rules: 5 Technical Required Elements.
1 Hybrid with Degree of Difficulty.
Four Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine (except connections).
One Choreography Hybrid (ChoHy) with a fixed Degree of Difficulty of 1.0.
5 Technical Required Elements.
1 Hybrid with Degree of Difficulty.
Four Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine (except connections).
One Choreography Hybrid (ChoHy) with a fixed Degree of Difficulty of 1.0.
5 Technical Required Elements.
1 Hybrid with Degree of Difficulty.
1 Pair Acrobatic (free choice).
Four Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine.
Two Pair Acrobatics (free choice but must not repeat the same acrobatic).
3 Technical Required Elements.
1 Hybrid with Degree of Difficulty.
1 Required Hybrid: only one Thrust declaration and 2 different Connection declarations (e.g. T8 C3 C4).
Pair Acrobatics must not repeat the same acrobatic.
Minimum of 3 declared Sustained Surface Connections ("SuCon") with travel (1 m or more) or rotation (180 degrees or more).
Three Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine.
One Choreography Hybrid (ChoHy) with a fixed Degree of Difficulty of 1.0.
Three Pair Acrobatics (free choice but must not repeat the same acrobatic).
Minimum of 4 declared Sustained Surface Connections ("SuCon") with travel (1 m or more) or rotation (180 degrees or more).
5 Technical Required Elements.
One Hybrid with Degree of Difficulty that must include a cadence action.
May contain a maximum of one (1) circle.
Two Team Acrobatics from two different main Groups.
Five Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine.
Three Team Acrobatics (free choice but must not repeat the same acrobatic).
Acrobatics must contain one from each Group (A, B, C, P).
Maximum of two Acrobatics from the same Group.
Must not repeat the same acrobatic.
Four Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine (except connections).
Four Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine.
One Pair Acrobatic (free choice).
Three Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine.
One Choreography Hybrid (ChoHy) with a fixed Degree of Difficulty of 1.0.
Two Pair Acrobatics (free choice but must not repeat the same acrobatic).
Minimum of 3 declared Sustained Surface Connections ("SuCon") with travel (1 m or more) or rotation (180 degrees or more).
Four Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine.
Three Team Acrobatics with Degree of Difficulty safety limit (free choice but must not repeat the same acrobatic).
Four Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine (except connections).
Four Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine.
One Pair Acrobatic (free choice).
Three Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine.
One Choreography Hybrid (ChoHy) with a fixed Degree of Difficulty of 1.0.
Two Pair Acrobatics (free choice but must not repeat the same acrobatic).
Minimum of 3 declared Sustained Surface Connections ("SuCon") with travel (1 m or more) or rotation (180 degrees or more).
Four Hybrids with Degree of Difficulty — must include one declaration from each family in the routine.
Three Team Acrobatics with Degree of Difficulty safety limit (free choice but must not repeat the same acrobatic).
Five Acrobatics with Degree of Difficulty safety limit.
Acrobatics must contain one from Group A, B and P. Group C is optional.
Maximum of two acrobatics from the same Group.
Must not repeat the same acrobatic.
One Solo DD Hybrid.
One Duet DD Hybrid.
One Team DD Hybrid (minimum of four athletes).
One Team ChoHy with a fixed Degree of Difficulty of 1.0 (minimum of four athletes).
Three acrobatics with Degree of Difficulty safety limit — must not repeat the same acrobatic.
Family declarations may be counted across the solo, duet and team DD hybrids (Appendix 6).

family_coverage_rule.rule: Each Free Routine MUST include a skill from every family (except Connections in Solo). All routine members must perform that skill in the same declaration on the Coach Card (not factored).
family_coverage_rule.exception_solo: Connections (C) family is excluded for Solo events.
family_coverage_rule.exception_free_combination: In Open Free Combination one declaration from each family may be counted across solo, duet and team DD hybrids.

per_hybrid_limits._source: Appendix 6 (2027) — General requirements c) and e)
notes: Max 5 declarations per family per Hybrid (raw count, factored or not).
Max 2x per technique (weighted: unfactored 1, *0.5 = 0.5, *0.3 = 0.3); with factors a technique may appear at most 4x.
Factoring limited to 10 code declarations per Hybrid: max 5 at *0.5 and max 5 at *0.3.
C4 and C4+ are the same technique.

no_repeat_acrobatic_definition.Group A: Cannot repeat same position(s) (as P1 or as P2), exception third position bonus.
no_repeat_acrobatic_definition.Group B: Cannot repeat same construction nor same connection (grip).
no_repeat_acrobatic_definition.Group P: Cannot repeat same construction, connection (grip), positions (P1 or P2, the third position itself may repeat) or bonus(es) — including the Pos3 bonus.

youth_12u_acrobatic_safety_limits._note: Team/Open acrobatics in 12U and Youth routines: total DD (incl. 0.50 Base Mark) must not exceed the group maximum.

age_restricted_codes._source: Team Acrobatic Catalogue (1P>H, H>1P, 1F>1F, 1F>1F+ not for 12U/Youth; RetSq, RetPa Senior/Junior only) + Appendix 7 Addendum (1FH/, 1F>1P not for 12U/Youth; Ret1Pa, RetF Senior/Junior only)

connections.1FH/: Not permitted for 12U and Youth (Base Mark).

bonuses.1F>1P: Not permitted for 12U and Youth (Base Mark).
bonuses.1F>1F: Not permitted for 12U and Youth (Base Mark).
bonuses.1F>1F+: Not permitted for 12U and Youth (Base Mark).

theme_required_routines._source: World Aquatics CR Part Seven - Acrobatic Routine and Free Combination must be presented with a declared theme/title on the coach card.
theme_required_routines.rule: The coach card for an Acrobatic Routine or a Free Combination must state the routine theme. A missing theme is a FAIL.
